premises.text: Monoclonal antibody drugs are hard to use and unaffordable because they cannot cross many tissue barriers, lack cold-chain-free stability, and have high manufacturing costs
premises.evidence_span: monoclonal antibodies, which have significant challenges, like their incapability to cross through most tissue barriers on the body, lack of stability out of cold chain, and high manufacturing costs

premises.text: Those limits confine antibodies to narrow applications and block drugs for many diseases affecting global populations
premises.evidence_span: This limits their use into a very narrow set of applications, making impossible the development of new antibody drugs for hundreds of diseases that affect most of the global population

premises.text: AMP platform fuses shark antibody CDR3 regions to a synthetic sea-snail conoprotein scaffold using molecular and AI processes without in vivo transgenic or cellular models
premises.evidence_span: Our synthetic antibody mimetic protein platform, or AMP for short, uses CDR3 regions from single-domain shark antibodies fused to a synthetic conoprotein scaffold from a sea snail

premises.text: AMPs are much smaller than monoclonal antibodies yet retain biological function, with tissue crossing, limited immunogenicity, hard-to-reach antigen targeting, and heat resistance
premises.evidence_span: Our AMPs are 40 times smaller than a monoclonal antibody, but with the same biological functions. Our AMPs can cross through tissue barriers, generate limited immune reactions even with no humanization, can target very small and hard to reach antigens, and are heat resistant

premises.text: Those properties enable previously impossible delivery forms such as aerosol, eye drops, viral delivery, or transdermal release
premises.evidence_span: the ability to develop Antibody drugs that have been impossible to develop, like antibody drugs in aerosol, in eye drops, viral delivery, or trans-thermal release

premises.text: Business model develops and preclinical-validates AMPs then out-licenses to pharma for upfront, milestone, and royalty payments
premises.evidence_span: we out-license our AMPs to pharmaceutical companies, generating revenue from upfront payments, clinical phase and approval milestones, and then royalties over sales of the marketed products

premises.text: Lead AMP1 for diabetic retinopathy aims to replace risky costly eye injections with home eye drops via proven tissue penetration and therapeutic activity
premises.evidence_span: you will be able to take your treatment in simple eye drops at home, no need for an eye injection

premises.text: Respiratory AMP leads show nanomolar neutralization of respiratory virus on lung cell culture comparable to approved antibody drugs
premises.evidence_span: Our AMP4 shown full neutralization capability over the COVID-19 virus on lung cell culture at nanomolar level. This is similar to FDA approved COVID-19 antibody drugs on the market
